exposure: Women with class I-III obesity who gained above IOM guidelines
Women with class I-III obesity who gained below IOM guidelines
Women with class I-III obesity who lost weight during pregnancy
Women with class I-III obesity who gained within IOM guidelines
cohort: 646,642 pregnant women with obesity from the 2014 U.S. birth certificate data
finding: The pattern of association between gestational weight gain and adverse outcomes was similar across all obesity classes, suggesting a possible singular gestational weight gain recommendation for all women with obesity.
